<?php
/**
 * StreamProxy - A lightweight PHP network proxy designed to sit behind nginx/haproxy
 * Handles connection pooling and request forwarding with resource management
 */

class ConnectionPool {
    private array $pool = [];
    private array $refCounts = [];
    private array $released = [];
    
    public function acquire(string $host, int $port): Connection {
        $key = "{$host}:{$port}";
        if (isset($this->pool[$key]) && !$this->isStale($this->pool[$key])) {
            $conn = $this->pool[$key];
            $this->refCounts[$key]++;
            return $conn;
        }
        $conn = new Connection($host, $port);
        $this->pool[$key] = $conn;
        $this->refCounts[$key] = 1;
        $this->released[$key] = false;
        return $conn;
    }
    
    public function release(string $key, bool $forceClose = false): void {
        if (!isset($this->pool[$key])) return;
        if ($this->released[$key] ?? false) return;
        $this->refCounts[$key]--;
        if ($this->refCounts[$key] <= 0 || $forceClose) {
            $this->pool[$key]->close();
            $this->released[$key] = true;
            unset($this->pool[$key]);
            unset($this->refCounts[$key]);
        }
    }
    
    public function isReleased(string $key): bool {
        return $this->released[$key] ?? false;
    }
    
    private function isStale(Connection $conn): bool {
        return (time() - $conn->getLastUsed()) > 30;
    }
}

class Connection {
    private $socket;
    private string $host;
    private int $port;
    private int $lastUsed;
    private bool $closed = false;
    
    public function __construct(string $host, int $port) {
        $this->host = $host;
        $this->port = $port;
        $this->socket = @fsockopen($host, $port, $errno, $errstr, 5);
        $this->lastUsed = time();
    }
    
    public function send(string $data): string|false {
        if ($this->closed || !$this->socket) return false;
        fwrite($this->socket, $data);
        $this->lastUsed = time();
        $response = '';
        stream_set_timeout($this->socket, 10);
        while (!feof($this->socket)) {
            $chunk = fread($this->socket, 8192);
            if ($chunk === false || $chunk === '') break;
            $response .= $chunk;
            if (strlen($response) > 1048576) break;
        }
        return $response;
    }
    
    public function close(): void {
        if ($this->socket && !$this->closed) {
            fclose($this->socket);
            $this->closed = true;
            $this->socket = null;
        }
    }
    
    public function getLastUsed(): int { return $this->lastUsed; }
    public function isClosed(): bool { return $this->closed; }
}

class ProxyHandler {
    private ConnectionPool $pool;
    private array $pendingCleanup = [];
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->pool = new ConnectionPool();
    }
    
    public function handleRequest(array $headers, string $body): string {
        $target = $this->resolveBackend($headers);
        if (!$target) return $this->errorResponse(502, 'Bad Gateway');
        
        $key = "{$target['host']}:{$target['port']}";
        $conn = $this->pool->acquire($target['host'], $target['port']);
        
        // Build forwarded request
        $request = $this->buildRequest($headers, $body, $target);
        if ($request === null) {
            $this->pool->release($key, true);
            return $this->errorResponse(400, 'Bad Request');
        }
        
        // Track for cleanup in case of X-Forwarded-Timeout from reverse proxy
        $this->pendingCleanup[] = $key;
        
        $response = $conn->send($request);
        
        // Handle upstream timeout signaled by reverse proxy header
        if ($response === false || $this->hasTimeoutSignal($headers)) {
            $this->cleanupTimedOut($key);
            return $this->errorResponse(504, 'Gateway Timeout');
        }
        
        // Normal cleanup
        $this->finalizeConnection($key, $headers);
        
        return $response;
    }
    
    private function cleanupTimedOut(string $key): void {
        // Force close on timeout
        $this->pool->release($key, true);
        // Remove from pending
        $this->pendingCleanup = array_filter(
            $this->pendingCleanup, fn($k) => $k !== $key
        );
    }
    
    private function finalizeConnection(string $key, array $headers): void {
        $keepAlive = $this->shouldKeepAlive($headers);
        if (!$keepAlive) {
            $this->pool->release($key, true);
        } else {
            $this->pool->release($key, false);
        }
    }
    
    private function hasTimeoutSignal(array $headers): bool {
        // Reverse proxy (nginx/haproxy) may signal impending timeout
        return isset($headers['X-Upstream-Timeout']) && 
               intval($headers['X-Upstream-Timeout']) < 1;
    }
    
    private function shouldKeepAlive(array $headers): bool {
        $connection = $headers['Connection'] ?? 'keep-alive';
        return strtolower($connection) !== 'close';
    }
    
    private function resolveBackend(array $headers): ?array {
        $host = $headers['X-Backend-Host'] ?? null;
        $port = intval($headers['X-Backend-Port'] ?? 80);
        if (!$host || !filter_var($host, FILTER_VALIDATE_IP)) return null;
        if ($port < 1 || $port > 65535) return null;
        // Only allow internal network backends
        if (!$this->isInternalNetwork($host)) return null;
        return ['host' => $host, 'port' => $port];
    }
    
    private function isInternalNetwork(string $ip): bool {
        return str_starts_with($ip, '10.') || 
               str_starts_with($ip, '172.16.') ||
               str_starts_with($ip, '192.168.');
    }
    
    private function buildRequest(array $headers, string $body, array $target): ?string {
        $method = $headers['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET';
        $path = $headers['REQUEST_URI'] ?? '/';

        // Prevent HTTP request splitting/smuggling: reject any CR/LF (or other
        // control chars) that could inject headers or a second request into the
        // upstream connection.
        if (preg_match('/[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/', $method) || preg_match('/[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/', $path)) {
            return null;
        }
        // Restrict method to a safe token set.
        if (!preg_match('/^[A-Za-z]+$/', $method)) {
            return null;
        }

        $req = "{$method} {$path} HTTP/1.1\r\n";
        $req .= "Host: {$target['host']}:{$target['port']}\r\n";
        $req .= "Content-Length: " . strlen($body) . "\r\n";
        $req .= "Connection: keep-alive\r\n";
        $req .= "\r\n";
        $req .= $body;
        return $req;
    }
    
    private function errorResponse(int $code, string $message): string {
        return "HTTP/1.1 {$code} {$message}\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n";
    }
    
    public function shutdown(): void {
        // Cleanup any remaining pending connections
        foreach ($this->pendingCleanup as $key) {
            if (!$this->pool->isReleased($key)) {
                $this->pool->release($key, true);
            }
        }
    }
}

// Main entry point - runs behind reverse proxy
$handler = new ProxyHandler();
$headers = getallheaders() ?: [];
$headers['REQUEST_METHOD'] = $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET';
$headers['REQUEST_URI'] = $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ?? '/';
$body = file_get_contents('php://input');

$response = $handler->handleRequest($headers, $body);
$handler->shutdown();

// Parse and forward response
$parts = explode("\r\n\r\n", $response, 2);
if (count($parts) === 2) {
    $headerLines = explode("\r\n", $parts[0]);
    foreach (array_slice($headerLines, 1) as $line) {
        // Defense-in-depth against response header injection: skip any line
        // containing embedded control characters.
        if ($line === '' || preg_match('/[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/', $line)) {
            continue;
        }
        header($line);
    }
    echo $parts[1];
} else {
    http_response_code(502);
}
